correctness.rationale: For every two-state Boolean relation matrix, off-diagonal square entries factor as m_ss*m_st OR m_st*m_tt, each factor recognized by a three-state unordered-pair NFA; the union gives a six-state epsilon-free NFA. Equal endpoints use a two-state original-path copy plus one unordered-pair component, giving five. Six literal binary fooling pairs give a 6x6 acceptance matrix with diagonal ones and at least one zero in every symmetric off-diagonal pair; the standard splicing argument proves a six-state lower bound. Standalone program checks 523264 finite cases and the literal witness.
